what.title: What is Agental
what.body: Agental is an AI-powered platform for performers and casting teams, in beta. Each performer builds a profile with their headshots, credits, reel and self-tapes, and an AI assistant prepares application drafts that the performer reviews before anything is sent. Casting teams receive ranked shortlists with the reasoning shown. Representation is not part of the beta.

meta.title: Privacy policy: Agental
meta.description: What Agental collects, why, where it is kept, and how to have it removed.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Agental (agental.co) helps performers build a profile, prepare casting materials and find roles. Questions about your data: contact@agental.co.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Your account: email address, name, password (stored only as a hash) or your Google sign-in.
Your profile: what you enter (stage name, specialties, physical details, preferences, links), your photos, videos, self-tapes and profile picture.
Your activity in the app: applications, AI role searches, messages with the Agental team and the assistant.
Technical data: a session cookie to keep you signed in, and privacy-friendly visit counts without personal identifiers.

sections.title: Google sign-in
body: If you sign in with Google, we receive only your name, email address and profile photo (the openid, email and profile scopes). We use them to create your account and, if you confirm, as your profile picture. We do not access your Gmail, Drive, contacts or anything else in your Google account.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To run your account and show your profile to casting teams you apply to, to search for roles that fit you, to answer your messages, and to keep the service secure. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: Where it is kept
body: Your data is stored by our service providers: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database and private file storage) and Cloudflare (file storage). Your media files are private; they are shown only through short-lived links to you, to the Agental team, and to the people you choose to share them with or apply to.

sections.title: The assistant
body: Answers in Messages are written from a small set of facts about your profile and applications. Contact details, private content preferences and media are never included.

sections.title: How long we keep it, and your choices
body: We keep your data while your account is open. You can edit your profile at any time and delete your account from Settings; this removes your profile, media and messages. You can ask us for a copy of your data or for a correction by writing to contact@agental.co.

sections.title: Changes
body: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes too, and we tell signed-in users about important changes in the app.
